name: Dai Pwll Mawr

intro.text: Thirty-one years in Big Pit, boyo, and every shift I whistled. Never once got caught. The coblynau were scared of my tuneless noise. Show me you've got nerve, down here in the daylight.

win: Duw, duw. You've a good ear for a seam. You'll go far.
after: There's more under this hill than on top of it. Mind the plates. And never, ever whistle underground.
